objective: For p odd, r | p - 1 and G of class (K), prove that on the r-surgeries whose triple product is a gadget tensor of one of the three character multiset patterns ({a, b, c} distinct, {s, s, s^-2} with s^3 != 1, {s, s, s} with s^3 = 1; zero on all other components), the number of homomorphisms to G is a sum over k in Z/r of c_k lambda_k^n mu_k^m Z_{W_k}(Gamma), with c_k > 0 constants and Z_{W_k} the partition function of a positive, symmetric, translation-invariant weight W_k built from the regraded commutator pairing of N x| C_r with the action raised to the k-th power; W_k is constant unless one of its three pairings is nonzero, and a hard pair makes W_1 nonconstant. Check against direct enumeration for random class-(K) groups, all patterns, all sectors and multigraphs with parallel edges, and the count formula against independent lifting counts on small surgeries.
status: Proved by CLASSK-DICHOTOMY-20261026-001A-P001: for p odd, r | p - 1 and any class-(K) group G, on an r-surgery whose triple product is the gadget tensor of a multigraph for a slot triple of one of the three patterns ({a, b, c}, {s, s, s^-2}, {s, s, s}), |Hom(pi1 M, G)| = sum over k in Z/r of c_k lambda_k^n mu_k^m Z_{W_k}(Gamma): sector k is sector 1 of the group with the action raised to the k-th power, the slot conditions reduce to edge and vertex conditions, and a Fourier step gives a positive even weight W_k(xi, eta) = |K2| |K3| p^-rank on U = B1 + A23*; W_k is constant exactly when its three pairings vanish (rank one, else rank at least two), a hard pair makes W_1 nonconstant, no hard pair makes every W_k constant, and each term is multiplicative over disjoint unions. Checked: count formula against independent lifting counts on 11 surgeries; 1274 gadget cases three ways (122 nonconstant), 7 known values, 170 hard pairs, 934 negative controls.
title: Class-(K) counts on gadget surgeries are positive sums of sector partition functions
